prompt: Create an ultra-realistic square travel portrait of a young woman on a high-rise New York City observation deck, photographed through floor-to-ceiling glass with the Manhattan skyline behind her. She is seated or leaning casually in the foreground, shoulders bare in an off-the-shoulder cream ribbed knit sweater, wearing a burgundy baseball cap embroidered with BROOKLYN, small gold hoop earrings, and a thin gold necklace. She has long dark curly hair, warm medium-brown skin with natural freckles, glossy lips, and closed eyes, smiling softly as she tilts her face up toward warm sunlight. Behind her, show the Empire State Building centered slightly left, distant skyscrapers and hazy water on the horizon under a clear blue sky. Add subtle white lettering on the glass reading OBSERVATION DECK and LEVEL 86 - 1,050 FT. Use natural golden-hour sunlight from the right, realistic reflections and vertical glass seams, shallow depth of field with the skyline slightly softened, crisp skin texture, cinematic color grading, authentic smartphone/editorial travel photography, no watermark, no extra text.

promptZh: 创作一张超写实的方形旅行人像，拍摄一位年轻女性在纽约市高层观景台的场景，透过落地玻璃拍摄，背景为曼哈顿天际线。她坐在前景或随意倚靠，身穿露肩米色罗纹针织衫，戴着一顶酒红色棒球帽，帽上绣有 BROOKLYN，佩戴小巧的金色圆环耳环和细金项链。她留着 长长的深色卷发，拥有温暖的中棕色皮肤和天然雀斑，嘴唇光泽，双眼微闭，面带柔和微笑，脸庞向上迎着温暖的阳光。背景中，帝国大厦位于画面中心偏左位置，远处的摩天大楼和地平线上的朦胧水域在晴朗蓝天下隐约可见。在玻璃上添加精致的白色文字 OBSERVATION DECK 和 LEVEL 86 - 1,050 FT。使用来自右侧的自然黄金时刻阳光，呈现写实的反射效果和垂直玻璃接缝，采用浅景深效果使天际线略微柔化，皮肤纹理清晰，电影级调色，呈现地道的智能手机/编辑类旅行摄影风格，无水印，无额外文字。
